mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within a month indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over two months signals increased consumer confidence and economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when the signal is active.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals increased economic output and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.1% in the same period, it indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over two months and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by less than 0.5% in the same period, it signals real demand growth without significant inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and CPIAUCSL increases < 0.5% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% over three months signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and increases investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% over six months and industrial production (INDPRO) grows by more than 1% in the same period, it indicates strong economic growth and increased corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% and INDPRO increases > 1% in 6 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.
